title: Paraguay: Peña Impeachment & Ueno Bank Crisis Update — Nov 09, 2026
summary: Multiple outlets report a guarantees judge ordered pretrial detention for ousted president Santiago Peña on 7 Nov in the Ueno Bank case, resolving the earlier house-arrest discrepancy. Pedro Alliana was sworn in to complete the term to 2028. Prosecutors also sought detention for ex-central bank chief Carlos Carvallo. No developments dated 9 Nov were found.
